subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Compares the length of objects concretely and sorts from longest to shortest (caterpillars, tubes)

show.line: Long and short! This caterpillar is long. This one is short. Which is the longest?

rounds.praise: Yes! That one is the longest.
Yes! That one is the shortest.

rounds.prompt: Look at the snake and the worm. Which one is longer? Say snake or worm.
Longest, then shorter, then shortest. Which row is in the right order?
rounds.praise: Yes! Longest to shortest, in order.

rounds.prompt: Long or short? Put each thing in its group.

hints: Put them side by side. Start at the same end.
Longest is the biggest stretch. Shortest is the smallest.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the longest caterpillar.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This tiny one! It is the longest.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That one is the shortest. The long one stretches furthest.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's line them up together. This one stretches the furthest. Longest!

parent_line: Can order things from longest to shortest.
